Read the following passage and answer the question by choosing the best option. Provide only the text of the correct option as your answer.

Passage: Their wild ways might already be the talk of Newport high society, but don't assume we've seen the best of Lillian and Beatrice Bellacourt quite yet. Because as these wine-swigging, bed-hopping sisters enter the limelight, their scandalous lifestyles are becoming exposed in all their debauched detail. We're talking sex, drugs and buckets of money – with a touch of incest thrown in for good measure. Not your average society darling, fame-hungry Lady Lillian isn't afraid to let down her perfectly coiffed hair, with her daringly extravagant soirées. To keep up with this upper-class party girl, you'll find yourself downing glasses of cocaine-wine, dodging a gun-toting matriarch and quite possibility getting into a fist-fight with a blind and deaf lady.
@highlight
Fictional content sponsored by Comedy Central
Query: Not to be outdone by her sister's escapades, @placeholder indulges in a few exploits of her own, including daring sexual dalliances.

Options : A. Newport
B. Lady Lillian
C. Comedy Central
D. Lillian
E. Beatrice Bellacourt

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the contetn of the correct option.
